sentences.en: And, you know, and I would look at like, you know, not on a personal level, but I was a big, my parents loved Woody Allen movies when I was a kid, you know,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我关注的不是个人层面，但我小时候，我父母非常喜欢伍迪·艾伦的电影，你知道的，

sentences.zh: 我当时几乎是被《汉娜姐妹》之类的电影给淹没了。

sentences.en: And, and Mel Brooks, I mean, I, I like, it's funny, like Spaceballs, like I watched Spaceballs before Star Wars probably a hundred million times, but, um,
sentences.zh: 还有梅尔·布鲁克斯，我的意思是，我……这很有趣，比如《太空炮弹》，我可能在看《星球大战》之前就已经看过几亿遍《太空炮弹》了，但是，嗯，

sentences.en: what's funny is I never had like too close of a plan or too specific of a goal, or I never looked at anyone's career really and was like, I want that career.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，我从来没有过太紧密的计划或太具体的目标，我也从来没有真正盯着谁的职业生涯看，然后说‘我想要那样的职业生涯’。

sentences.en: I, I, I think when I was in my early twenties, I sort of surpassed any expectation I could have had for myself in many ways.
sentences.zh: 我觉得在我二十出头的时候，我在很多方面就已经超越了我对自己所有的期望。

sentences.en: And, and, and after that, I sort of saw that like the greatest gift I could give to myself was to like,
sentences.zh: 在那之后，我意识到我能给自己的最好礼物就是，

sentences.en: do whatever creatively excited me in whatever moment I was in and not working towards something where like, I'll only be happy if I do this.
sentences.zh: 在任何时刻，去做任何让我感到兴奋的创作，而不是为了某个目标而工作，比如‘只有做了这个我才会快乐’。

sentences.en: And if once I do this, I'll know I've made it, you know, like I, I, I, I felt like I made it when I was 23 years old.
sentences.zh: 或者‘一旦我做了这个，我就知道我成功了’，你知道，我感觉我在23岁时就已经成功了。

sentences.en: And so after that, I was like, I, I think I should just do what seems exciting to me.
sentences.zh: 所以在那之后，我就想，我觉得我应该只做那些让我觉得兴奋的事情。

sentences.en: And, and, and it is funny because sometimes I will do an interview and look back and I'll be like, wow, I'm doing a lot of, it's a lot of stuff and it's,
sentences.zh: 这很有趣，因为有时我接受采访时回过头来看，我会想，哇，我确实做了很多事情，而且，

sentences.en: and it's a weird array of stuff.
sentences.zh: 这些事情的种类非常奇特。

sentences.en: And, but I look at, and it's a stuff, it's stuff that truly reflects my taste and who I am and my sensibilities.
sentences.zh: 但我看了一下，这些确实反映了我的品味、我的身份以及我的审美倾向。

sentences.en: Me and Evan grew up reading comic books.
sentences.zh: 我和埃文是看着漫画书长大的。

sentences.en: We were, that's one of the first things we bonded on.
sentences.zh: 那是我们最早建立联系的事情之一。

sentences.en: And so getting to adapt comic books,
sentences.zh: 所以能够去改编漫画书，

sentences.en: Garth Ennis, one of my favorite comic book writers of all time.
sentences.zh: 加斯·恩尼斯，我最喜欢的漫画作家之一。

sentences.en: So getting to make Preacher and the boys and things like that, especially like, you know, I remember when like David Fincher was attached to make Preacher
sentences.zh: 所以能制作《传教士》和《黑袍纠察队》之类的作品，特别是，你知道，我记得当时大卫·芬奇曾打算制作《传教士》，

sentences.en: and then it fell apart and we ended up making it.
sentences.zh: 后来项目黄了，最后是我们把它做出来了。

sentences.en: And the boys, like every big director in Hollywood was attached to adapt the boys at one point or another.
sentences.zh: 还有《黑袍纠察队》，好莱坞的每一位大导演在某个阶段都曾被传要改编它。

sentences.en: And we just sort of like hung out in the background for a decade
sentences.zh: 而我们只是在幕后徘徊了十年，

sentences.en: until everyone else fell through and we became the most viable option to produce it.
sentences.zh: 直到其他人都没做成，我们成了制作它的最可行人选。

sentences.en: Who turned it down?
sentences.zh: 是谁拒绝了它？

sentences.en: It wasn't when they turned it down.
sentences.zh: 不是他们拒绝了它。

sentences.en: It didn't work out.
sentences.zh: 是没谈成。

sentences.en: It just didn't work out.
sentences.zh: 就是没谈成。

sentences.en: They kept making versions.
sentences.zh: 他们一直在制作不同版本。

sentences.en: It is tricky, and we changed it quite a bit from the source material, I think, to make it into something that was far more digestible
sentences.zh: 这确实很棘手，我认为我们对原著做了相当大的改动，把它变成了一种比原著更易于消化、

sentences.en: as visual entertainment than it would have been otherwise, you know?
sentences.zh: 更适合视觉娱乐的东西，你懂吗？

sentences.en: Um, but I, I think like the greatest gift I have in my career is that I truly,
sentences.zh: 嗯，但我认为我职业生涯中得到的最大礼物就是，我真的，

sentences.en: we can kind of do anything and we can make dramatic things and comedic things and animated things and live action things and things like Ninja Turtles, honestly,
sentences.zh: 我们可以做任何事，我们可以制作剧情片、喜剧片、动画片、真人电影，还有像《忍者神龟》这样的作品，老实说，

sentences.en: like has been one of my favorite things we've made in years.
sentences.zh: 那是我多年来制作的最喜欢的作品之一。

sentences.en: And like, I love that movie.
sentences.zh: 我真的很喜欢那部电影。

sentences.en: And I think it's so good and so reflective of my taste and my sensibility and what I loved when I was a kid,
sentences.zh: 我觉得它非常棒，非常能反映我的品味、我的审美以及我小时候所热爱的东西，

sentences.en: but also infused with like the highest level of writing and storytelling and plot construction that I could fathomably have helped conceive of in that time in my life.
sentences.zh: 同时也融入了我在那个生命阶段所能构思出的最高水平的剧本、叙事和情节构建。

sentences.en: And I look at how it's constructed from like a structure and story standpoint.
sentences.zh: 我审视了它是如何从结构和故事的角度构建出来的。

sentences.en: And I'm like legitimately very proud of it.
sentences.zh: 我确实为此感到非常自豪。

sentences.en: And I think like, oh, that is like as well structured a film as you can make in many ways.
sentences.zh: 我觉得，哦，那在很多方面都是一部结构极其严谨的电影。

sentences.en: And my hope is that our work just clearly has had the highest level of thought and care and consideration put into it, no matter what it is.
sentences.zh: 我希望我们的作品无论是什么，都能清楚地体现出最高水平的思考、关怀和考量。

sentences.en: And like, as risk averse as Hollywood is, I'm always trying to instill in the people that we work with, like, if we can take a swing, let's take it.
sentences.zh: 尽管好莱坞非常厌恶风险，但我总是试图向与我们合作的人灌输一点：如果我们能放手一搏，那就去做吧。

sentences.en: If no one's looking, let's do something crazy.
sentences.zh: 如果没人注意，我们就做点疯狂的事。

sentences.en: If no one's, if we're in this moment where no one's paying attention, like, let's, let's make Ninja Turtles look insane.
sentences.zh: 如果我们正处于一个没人关注的时刻，那就让《忍者神龟》看起来疯狂一点。

sentences.en: Like, let's, let's really push it.
sentences.zh: 我们要真正去推动它。

sentences.en: And to me, I also hope our work has that sort of, like, intrepid spirit, like a spirit of that we are going for it and that we are not playing it safe,
sentences.zh: 对我来说，我也希望我们的作品能有那种无畏的精神，那种我们全力以赴、不走寻常路的精神，

sentences.en: but we are swinging for the fences, you know?
sentences.zh: 我们是在全力冲击，你懂吗？

sentences.zh: 塞斯·罗根，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: We'll speak again.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后再聊。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.zh: 我们回来了。

sentences.en: We're back.
sentences.zh: 我们回来了。

sentences.en: All right.

sentences.en: In our first conversation, we talked about opportunities for young people coming up in Hollywood and how the industry has changed.
sentences.zh: 在我们的第一次谈话中，我们讨论了年轻人进入好莱坞的机会以及行业的变化。

sentences.en: and possibly, you know, someone like you wouldn't have the same sort of opportunities to make movies today.
sentences.zh: 可能，你知道，像你这样的人今天可能不会有同样的机会去拍电影了。

sentences.en: And then we just saw two YouTubers dominate the box office.
sentences.zh: 然后我们刚刚看到两名YouTuber统治了票房。

sentences.en: One of them, Cain Parsons, the director of Backrooms, is 20.
sentences.zh: 其中一位，《后室》的导演凯恩·帕森斯，才20岁。

sentences.en: He was 16 when he made the YouTube video the movie is based on.
sentences.zh: 他制作这部电影所基于的YouTube视频时才16岁。

sentences.en: And then Curry Barker, the director of Obsession, is 26.
sentences.zh: 还有《Obsession》的导演柯里·巴克，26岁。

sentences.en: These have just been like huge successes.
sentences.zh: 这些都取得了巨大的成功。

sentences.en: I mean, what do you make of that?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你对此怎么看？

sentences.en: I mean, honestly, it totally fits in line with advice that I have been giving people for years when they come up to me, which is they say I want to make it in movies.
sentences.zh: 老实说，这完全符合我多年来给那些来找我的人的建议，他们说‘我想在电影界出人头地’。

sentences.en: I want to do something.
sentences.zh: ‘我想做点什么’。

sentences.en: And I tell them, like, make stuff and make stuff that is really good.
sentences.zh: 我告诉他们：‘去创作，去创作真正好的东西’。

sentences.en: And I'm like, trust me, people like me are, like, begging, praying that they see something impressive.
sentences.zh: 我跟他们说，相信我，像我这样的人都在乞求、祈祷能看到令人印象深刻的东西。

sentences.en: I met with Kane when I think he was 16 or 17 years old because I watched his YouTube videos.
sentences.zh: 我在凯恩16或17岁时就见过他，因为我看了他的YouTube视频。

sentences.en: And I remember the people at my company being like, why are we meeting with a 16-year-old?
sentences.zh: 我记得我公司的人问：‘我们为什么要见一个16岁的孩子？’

sentences.en: And I was like, trust me, this kid is very talented, you know?
sentences.zh: 我说：‘相信我，这孩子非常有天赋，你知道吗？’

sentences.en: And so ever since our phones had cameras on them, basically, I've been, that has become my default advice to people.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上自从我们的手机有了摄像头，这就成了我给人们的默认建议。

sentences.en: And now with Blender and visual effects and things like that, people – like literally on a laptop,
sentences.zh: 现在有了Blender和视觉特效之类的东西，人们——真的就在笔记本电脑上，

sentences.en: you can make a thing that when I was growing up would cost you tens of millions of dollars, you know.
sentences.zh: 就能做出我小时候需要花费数千万美元才能做出来的东西，你知道吗？

sentences.en: It has really opened the door for people who are skilled and dedicated to really show what they're capable of, you know.
sentences.zh: 这确实为那些技术娴熟、专注投入的人打开了大门，让他们真正展示自己的能力，你知道吗。

sentences.en: And I think that that's a great thing.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一件好事。

sentences.en: Hollywood always seems to be in the middle of like an angsty crisis.
sentences.zh: 好莱坞似乎总是处于一种焦虑的危机之中。

sentences.en: Variety called what just happened with these two YouTubers a, quote, tectonic shift in
sentences.zh: 《综艺》杂志称这两位YouTuber刚才所做的事情为‘地壳运动般的转变’，

sentences.en: Hollywood that sent shockwaves through the industry.
sentences.zh: 这在业内引发了冲击波。

sentences.en: I do wonder, first of all, what you make of that.
sentences.zh: 首先，我很好奇你对此有何看法。

sentences.en: I mean, do you think that's overstating what just happened?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你认为这是否夸大了刚刚发生的事情？

sentences.en: Because I guess what I think is so alluring to executives is that YouTubers, as you just mentioned, have cheap technology that they can use to get millions of eyeballs.
sentences.zh: 因为我想，对高管们来说最有吸引力的是，正如你刚才提到的，YouTuber们拥有廉价的技术，可以用它来吸引数百万观众。

sentences.en: They can workshop an idea.
sentences.zh: 他们可以打磨一个创意。

sentences.en: And then have a built-in audience, so I guess it takes the guesswork out of selling tickets.
sentences.zh: 然后拥有现成的受众，所以我想这省去了卖票时的猜测过程。

sentences.en: So I'm just wondering how you see it, since you already were tracking him for so long.
sentences.zh: 所以我只是想知道你是怎么看的，因为你已经关注他很久了。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, I don't know if, like, online engagement necessarily translates into, like, ticket sales.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，我不知道在线互动是否一定会转化为票房收入。

sentences.en: Definitely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: You know what I mean?
sentences.zh: 你明白我的意思吗？

sentences.en: Um, but I think to your first part of the question, like, I think it's overstating that it's a tectonic shift.
sentences.zh: 嗯，但对于你问题的前半部分，我认为说这是‘地壳运动般的转变’确实夸大了。

sentences.en: If your assumption is that these shifts don't happen constantly in Hollywood, you know, like, and I think that's something me and Evan talk about a lot is it's from network.
sentences.zh: 如果你认为这些转变在好莱坞不是经常发生的话，你知道，我认为我和埃文经常讨论的一点是，这源于《电视台风云》。

sentences.en: Like I always think of that line of network where Robert Duvall is like, it's a volatile industry and the investors are like, well, we, we shouldn't be,
sentences.zh: 我总是想起《电视台风云》里罗伯特·杜瓦尔说的那句台词，他说这是一个动荡的行业，投资者说‘好吧，我们不应该……’，

sentences.en: why are we financially invested in a, in a volatile industry?
sentences.zh: ‘我们为什么要投资一个动荡的行业？’

sentences.en: And, and, but I think by definition, it is a volatile industry, you know, um, and it changes and,
sentences.zh: 但我认为从定义上讲，它就是一个动荡的行业，你知道，嗯，它在不断变化，

sentences.en: and it's almost the one defining feature of Hollywood from my experience in it is that there is every few years a tectonic shift.
sentences.zh: 根据我的经验，好莱坞的一个定义性特征就是每隔几年就会发生一次地壳运动般的转变。

sentences.en: And thank God it's not really my job to be overly invested in these trends, I guess.
